advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test: attested unscoped opcert with an unresolvable configured gate ref (no origin remote) returns stale-head with the 'refusing to certify against the working tree' reason (exercises the SnapshotError fail-closed arm).
evidence:
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py:478-486: `try:
    head = resolve_ref(ref, working, fetch=False)
except SnapshotError:
    ... return ("cannot confirm the code the plan was reviewed against is current: ... refusing to certify against the working tree")`
Commit message: 'fail CLOSED honestly when the gate ref cannot be resolved (never emit a foreign value)'

ABSENCE: search for 'could not be resolved' in tests/unit/test_attestation_invalidation.py returned (no matches); the two new tests both push origin/main so resolve_ref always succeeds — the SnapshotError branch is never entered.
Named violating input: attested unscoped opcert with REBAR_GATE_REF=origin/main but NO origin remote configured (or the ref deleted) — resolve_ref('origin/main', ...) raises SnapshotError.
tests/conftest.py:501-502: defaults REBAR_GATE_SOURCE=attested unless a test overrides it
ABSENCE: search for SOURCE_LOCAL / GATE_SOURCE in tests/unit/test_attestation_invalidation.py returned (no matches); both new tests run under the attested default.
advisory.finding: The new SnapshotError fail-closed arm of `_unscoped_head_drift` (attested opcert whose configured gate ref cannot be resolved locally -> returns the 'refusing to certify against the working tree' stale-head reason) has no test. This is newly introduced behavior (all of `_unscoped_head_drift` is added, lines 456-489) and is the commit's headline contract ('fail CLOSED honestly when the gate ref cannot be resolved (never emit a foreign value)'). Named violating input: an attested unscoped opcert evaluated where the configured gate ref (origin/main) is unresolvable — e.g. no `origin` remote pushed / ref deleted — must return the honest cannot-resolve reason, not certify. A regression that fell through to a working-tree read here would not be caught.
merged_from: The new `source=local` arm of `_unscoped_head_drift` (attested manifest but gate_source.default_source != SOURCE_ATTESTED -> working-tree head_sha comparison, lines 474-475) is untested. The conftest defaults REBAR_GATE_SOURCE=attested and neither new test overrides it to 'local', so this added branch is never executed. Named violating input: an attested unscoped opcert evaluated with REBAR_GATE_SOURCE=local should compare against the in-place working-tree HEAD (its documented basis), not the gate ref.
scenarios: Evaluator sits in a repo where the configured gate ref is unresolvable locally (no origin, deleted ref); the fail-closed honest-refusal contract silently regresses to a working-tree read and no test detects it.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a test mirroring test_attested_unscoped_head_freshness_reads_gate_ref_not_working_tree but WITHOUT calling _push_main_to_origin (so origin/main is unresolvable), asserting result['valid'] is False, result['verdict'] == 'stale-head', and the reason contains 'refusing to certify against the working tree'.
